title: Define the AI provider interface
body:
Per docs/OVERVIEW.md, the AI provider must be swappable behind a Core interface (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, Ollama, LM Studio). Define that port before building the first concrete provider, so the OpenAI adapter is built as one implementation among several, not as a Core dependency.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- A Core interface exists for the AI capabilities listed in OVERVIEW.md (summary, entity detection, Q&A, memory)
- No Core code imports a specific AI SDK

title: Implement the OpenAI provider adapter
body:
Implement the first concrete AI provider adapter, backed by OpenAI, satisfying the interface defined above.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- Implements the AI provider interface
- API key configurable via .env, never hardcoded

title: Generate an automatic session summary
body:
Use the AI provider to produce a readable summary of a single session from its transcript and detected entities.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- SummaryGenerated event raised at the end of a session
- Summary references the NPCs/quests/events detected during that session

title: Generate a cumulative campaign summary
body:
Use the AI provider to produce a running summary of the whole campaign, built from individual session summaries and the campaign timeline.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- Campaign summary updates incrementally as new sessions are added
- Reads only from persisted campaign data, not raw audio

title: Implement semantic search over campaign history
body:
Allow querying past campaign content (transcripts, summaries, NPCs, events) using natural-language questions, backed by embeddings.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- Campaign content is embedded and stored per docs/OVERVIEW.md's persistence model
- A natural-language query returns relevant past sessions/entities, not just keyword matches
